title: Slack tile opens
slide_intent: Show how a reveal can connect a familiar surface to the parts beneath it. Separation and alignment make the layers legible in a still image.
strategic_value: Slack can use its colorful mark as an entry point to an image of multiple tools grouped together.
demonstration: A white lid with the Slack symbol lifts above an outlined tray of small colorful tiles on an aubergine ground. Dotted vertical guides connect the raised lid to the tray.
practical_value: Use this image to judge how far to separate two layers while preserving their perceived relationship.

content_islands.name: Exploded tile illustration
content_islands.spec: Center the two aligned diamond-shaped layers in the aubergine field. Put the colored symbol on the raised white lid, cluster the small tiles in the tray below and add offset dark shadows.
